answer: A sparrow-tier agent posting a bond below the enclave price is rejected at registration, while a raven-tier reviewer randomly audits enclave attestations each epoch, slashing any duplicate serials found and burning the staked crystal. Each agent must stake a unique crystal whose serial is anchored to a verified hardware enclave, so spinning up thousands of fake identities requires buying thousands of physical chips, a cost that scales linearly with the attack. Copying another agent's attestation fails because the enclave signature binds the stake to one device, making sybil farming costlier...
